compatibility_patch.patch_summary: Optional artifact handling now treats INFRA-008 and PAPER-018 docs as valid whether absent or present. Absent artifacts report presence=absent, status=absent, parse_status=not_applicable, and the expected repo-relative path. Present artifacts report presence=present and parse_status=parsed or parse_failed without requiring A to be merged into B.
